decision_summary: QIF v0.6.12 Trace CLI is release-ready.
rationale: The change is bounded to structural trace inspection, keeps semantic truth boundaries explicit, and passed trace, validate-all, and npm test verification.
recommendation: Release v0.6.12 and keep deeper graph traversal or open-risk CLI for later slices.
expected_user_reaction: Users can inspect why an entity is connected to evidence without knowing each schema by hand.
